text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Like this? Yeah... Yeah! I get it now! So
what if it's
longer? This race is in the
bag!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Just gotta keep my breathin' steady till
the end...
then finish with a bang!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yup, I've got it down pat. No way am I
forgettin'
this pace now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as planned, Tamamo Cross nails her

technique in the run-up to the spring
Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But y'know what, Trainer? Sure is nice
seein' your
goals comin' into view.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, I've been runnin' in the Twinkle
Series for a
while now, yeah? And sure, I
got me some wins...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But what I want is a win I can brag to my
family
about! Somethin' that screams
"BIG deal!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And the spring Tenno Sho's a race my
dad's
always wanted to see me in...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I think we got a real shot now, don't
we?! C'mon,
let's do my family proud!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! I'm gettin' shivers here! We're
finally
doin' it!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's head for the Tenno Sho (Spring)!
Yeah, let's head to the Tenno Sho (Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: C'mon, Trainer, we gotta get that shield for my dad. Until then, we go hard at trainin'!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And we're not the only ones
experiencing a
building wave of hype.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And Oguri Cap wins her second graded
race in a
row!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
A grueling comeback from the rear!
Right when it
looked like her legs were
about to give out, she
stormed her way
to victory! 2,000 meters of turf
and still
no trouble!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Okay, now I just have to keep this up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Spirits and tensions are high in the
racing world.
The senior runners are
abuzz prepping for the
Tenno Sho, and
the classic runners eagerly await
both
the Triple Crown and the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And at the same time, Oguri Cap, a
rising star
from the regionals, is picking
up momentum for
her third wave...
